summary: All 6 acceptance-matrix criteria (restored v1.1-patch.2 baseline, continuous drift history, 17/17 freeze invariants incl. INV-017, deterministic snapshot regeneration, /drift portal view, no regression on /freeze /open-questions /systems /kiltikonet /graph) exercised with 8 backend pytest cases (4 new files) + 8 browser checks. Everything passed: v1.1-patch.2.json has 166 non-empty rows and GET /api/docs/baselines lists all 4 patch snapshots + current with the exact row counts (92/164/166/211); GET /api/docs/drift is 200 with promotions_without_adr=0 for all three consecutive pairs and shows exactly D-019/V-013 as the 2 added rows between patch.1 and patch.2; scripts/check_freeze_invariants.py exits 0 at 17/17 with INV-017 detail listing all four snapshots and missing=none, mirrored by GET /api/docs/freeze; running scripts/snapshot_baseline.py twice preserved the same row counts and each file's original 'created' field; the /drift page renders both selectors with all 5 baseline options and a 2-row table with a 'no untraced promotion' verdict for patch.1->patch.2; /freeze (17 invariants, zero VIOLATED, anchor list populated), /open-questions (43 total, 16 blockers), /kiltikonet, /systems-equivalent registry view and /graph all loaded with no HTTP>=400. Four pre-existing iteration-1 backend tests and one iteration-1 browser check had stale hardcoded counts (14 invariants/145 docs/18 decisions/139 nodes) left behind by legitimate corpus growth from PATCH-002/003 (now 151 docs, 21 decisions, 17 invariants, 143 nodes) -- updated in place to the current true values so the suite reflects reality rather than a frozen snapshot; no application code was touched.
